bugs.title: Timed-out exit that later fills is booked under the cancelled stop id and labelled SL
bugs.impact: P&L is right, but the ledger names the wrong order and calls a trailing-stop exit a stop-loss, so reviews and EOD ledger checks fail daily.
bugs.root_cause: The FILLED branch of sweep_unresolved_orders (main.py) never gave the filled exit id to the tracked position; book_close() then wrote pos.sl_order_id (the cancelled stop), and _poll_close_exit_types() defaulted the label to SL.
bugs.fix: Sweep sets pos.sl_order_id to the filled exit; a full exit records its label in TrackedPosition.claimed_exit before sending, and the poll books the close under it. Tests: test_exit_timeout_safety.py (JSWENERGY replay, TestPollCloseLabel).

history.note: fixed 2026-10-31, uncommitted; needs one clean session with a timed-out exit to verify

bugs.title: Phantom SUNPHARMA 66-share legs on the BREAKOUT-PY and EVWAP-EARLY-PY strategy pages
bugs.impact: Strategy pages showed P&L the fills do not back: -600.6 on 10-28, +1,695.0 on 10-30; pages-vs-fills failed every day.
evidence: strategy_closed_trades id 1062: phantom LONG 66 closed at -1,531.2
bugs.root_cause: 10-26 10:33 restart restore attributed EVWAP's 66 shares to BREAKOUT-PY (_direction_name regression, fixed in 297ca5428). The strategy book kept strategy_positions rows 159 (-66) and 203 (+66).
bugs.fix: Zeroed quantity and average_price on strategy_positions 159 and 203 (backup db/backups/openalgo-pre-sunpharma-phantom-fix-20261031.db). Already-closed rows on 10-27/28/30 keep the phantom realised P&L; not rewritten.

history.note: data fix 2026-10-31; pages-vs-fills on the next session must show no SUNPHARMA phantom leg

bugs.title: After a restart the one-position-per-symbol cap is empty, so a second entry replaces the first and its stop is cancelled
bugs.impact: A held position lost its stop and tracking for hours (BEL 218 short, 10:30 to 14:45); in live mode an unprotected position.
evidence: log 2026-10-28 11:56:14 Duplicate SL for BEL confirmed cancelled ['26102805051735', '26102842746844']
bugs.root_cause: RiskEngine symbol counts are in memory only; startup restore registered positions without counting them, so can_trade_symbol passed EVWAP's 11:55 BEL entry; tracker.register overwrote the first leg and the duplicate-stop cleanup cancelled its stop 26102842746844.
bugs.fix: Startup seeds the symbol counts from restored positions (RiskEngine.seed_concentration); entry gate declines a symbol the strategy already tracks. Tests: test_restart_position_guards.py.

bugs.title: Startup reconcile misses a leg closed while another strategy holds the same symbol
bugs.impact: A stopped-out trade is never booked: HDFCBANK -1,049 missing from the engine's books and risk counters.
bugs.root_cause: The closed-while-down check only looks at symbols the broker shows flat; the restore adopts only legs on the broker's net side. EVWAP's short sat behind BREAKINGTRADE's long.
bugs.fix: _book_legs_hidden_by_another_strategy books such a leg from its own completed closing order (same strategy tag, opposite side, full size) with the real order id, or alerts. Tests: test_restart_position_guards.py.

bugs.title: 14:45 time exit used closeposition, which closed every strategy's positions
bugs.impact: Other strategies' positions closed without being booked (10-28: JSWENERGY +849, TATAPOWER -501, BEL).
bugs.fix: Time exit closes only the strategy's own tracked MIS legs, one order each (tracker._close_strategy).
bugs.verification: 10-29 and 10-30 EOD: no untagged close-all fills, no cross-strategy closes.

bugs.title: Sizing decline says entry price too high when the entry is below the strategy's minimum price
bugs.impact: Misleading decline reason in Telegram and trades.db (TATASTEEL 169.10 vs min 300).
evidence: 8 declines 10-26..10-29: TATASTEEL, VEDL, RECLTD, ITC, ASHOKLEY
bugs.root_cause: main._resolve_entry_quantity used one fixed message for every zero-quantity cause.
bugs.fix: RiskEngine.zero_quantity_reason names the price band or the risk budget. Tests: test_risk_sizing.py TestZeroQuantityReason.

bugs.title: Order and history calls time out 25-30 s after 5-minute candle closes
bugs.impact: Order timeouts drive every bookkeeping bug above; a 20-minute positionbook outage on 10-28 left the engine blind.
bugs.root_cause: Not found. Flattrade disconnects plus OpenAlgo slowness at candle boundaries; 04a29664f (quote request sharing) did not remove it.

bugs.title: EVWAP-EARLY-PY charges exceed its gross edge
bugs.impact: Week 10-26..10-30: gross -10,923, charges 11,256 on 225 entries (about 50 per round trip).
bugs.root_cause: Win rate 49%, avg win 484 vs avg loss 510; per-trade cost is about the size of the edge. Frozen strategy: observation only, no tuning from early P&L (5 sessions this week, min stop raised to 0.40% on 10-28).
